"'''Nubs's Big Mistake / The Jedi Rescue'''" is the fourth episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Two|second season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[August 14]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement" />

==Official description==
''Yoda joins Nubs on a mission. Wes is captured.''
